title: 第二章 扮演系统，名为米花的舞台！
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

数天前……

一双漆黑的脚踏足在陌生的土地上。

这个人，居然在米花下了车！

脑子坏掉了吗？

喂！快回来啊！

“不必担心，因为……”漆黑的人影摆出了一个新房45度回头杀，朝着空气露出了狞笑：“我才是杀人的一方。”

【看得出来，玩家精神状态良好，还有心情在玩梗。】

一个带有文字的光幕出现在漆黑人影的周围，吐槽对方的行为。

事实上，这里根本不是车站，周围也没有对着小黑人惊呼的NPC，小黑人也并非犯泽先生。刚刚的片段只是小黑人在自娱自乐，用自己的外表玩梗罢了。

不过这里确实是米花。

站在米花町一座高楼的顶端的，是一个全身被笼罩在漆黑之中，令读者看不见正体的小黑人，身份不明、性别不明、年龄不明。

小黑人没有搭理光屏文字对自己的吐槽，站在天台上，双手张开意图拥抱天空。

“LadiesandGentlemen！”

黑影对着空无一人的天空演讲：

“大家早上好，晚上好，或者中午好。我的名字是渚琰，如果不认识就读‘主演’就好——没错这是我刚编的名字，因为我就是这部大戏的主演，所以我干脆就叫渚琰，这样我下一次出场的时候你们就不会认不出来我是谁了。”

这里是米花市政大楼的顶端，距离地面两百五十米高，向下俯瞰米花町就如同沙盘模型一般。

“大家大概想问我为什么要站在这里，答案是大运当头，避无可避。”

渚琰对穿越前最后的记忆只有一串绝望的鸣笛音。

然后眼睛一闭一睁，发现自己上天台了。

一低头，发现自己的手脚都是黑漆漆的——自己变成了一个雌雄莫辨的小黑人。

再抬头，一块发光的屏幕在自己的眼前。

【亲爱的玩家94250，感谢您绑定并使用本系统，本系统为角色扮演系统，玩家可以消耗角色卡创建一个对应的分身并完全掌控，角色将从舞台上退场。】

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

A few days ago…

A pair of dark feet stepped on a strange land.

This man actually got off the bus at Mihua!

Is your brain broken?

Hello!Come back soon!

"Don't worry, because..." The dark figure turned around at a 45-degree angle to kill, and smiled ferociously into the air: "I am the one who killed him."

[It can be seen that the player is in good spirits and is still in the mood to play tricks.】

A light screen with text appeared around the dark figure, complaining about the other person's behavior.

In fact, this is not a station at all, and there are no NPCs around who exclaim to the little black man, and the little black man is not Mr. Ze.The clip just now was just a little black man amusing himself and using his appearance to make fun of himself.

But this is indeed rice krispies.

Standing on the top of a tall building in Yoneka Town is a little black man whose whole body is shrouded in darkness, making the reader unable to see his true body. His identity, gender and age are unknown.

The little black man ignored the complaints made by the text on the screen and stood on the rooftop with his hands open, intending to embrace the sky.

"Ladies and Gentlemen!"

The black shadow spoke to the empty sky:

"Good morning, good evening, or good noon, everyone. My name is Zhu Yan. If you don't know me, just call me 'starring' - yes, this is a name I just made up, because I am the lead actor in this drama, so I'll just call me Zhu Yan, so that you won't recognize who I am when I appear next time."

This is the top of the Miwa Municipal Building, 250 meters above the ground. Looking down at Miwa Town is like a sandbox model.

"You may want to ask me why I am standing here. The answer is that luck is on my side and there is no way to avoid it."

Zhuyan's last memory before traveling through time was a series of desperate whistle sounds.

Then he closed and opened his eyes and found that he was on the rooftop.

When he lowered his head, he found that his hands and feet were all pitch black - he had turned into a little black man whose gender was indistinguishable.

Looking up again, a glowing screen was in front of him.

[Dear player 94250, thank you for binding and using this system. This system is a role-playing system. Players can consume character cards to create a corresponding avatar and fully control it. The character will exit from the stage.】
